meta.body_summary: Add --preplanned flag to skip expensive terraform plan operations by reading existing plan files, with concurrent multi-directory support and auto-detection of JSON vs binary formats.

core_change_summary.description: Added --preplanned flag to main.go that, when set, reads plan files from each directory instead of running terraform plan. Implemented GetPlanFromFile() in pkg/terraform/plan.go to parse JSON plans directly or invoke terraform show for binary plans, using concurrency. Added e2e tests for preplanned scenarios and updated test utilities.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: README.md documents the new flag usage; test_utils.go adds helper for preplanned tests; plan_test.go was added then removed (unit tests moved to e2e).
change_trajectory: Initial commit: full implementation of --preplanned flag with unit tests and e2e tests.
Second commit: remove unit tests that required terraform CLI (rely on e2e).
Third commit: skip multi-directory preplanned e2e test for terraform < 0.14.

collaboration_trajectory: Claude Code authored all changes; maintainer busser merged the PR ~20 minutes after creation without any review comments or interaction.
